commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Braun can now Echo, Bye Function added
feat: Added list tracking, Additional Braun Easter Eggs Included
feat: Added unmarking feature on List

feat: add custom exception handling and input validation (Level-5, A-Exceptions) - Introduce BraunException to represent application-specific domain errors. - Refactor command dispatch in Braun.java to use structured exception throwing and handling. - Add granular error diagnostics for unknown commands, malformed parameters, empty descriptions, and invalid task indices. - Update UI test plan to cover error test cases, boundary checks, and state integrity verification.
feat: add delete command and migrate to ArrayList (Level-6, A-Collections)
commitResults.messageBody:
- Replace fixed Task[100] array with dynamic ArrayList<Task> storage.
- Implement 'delete' command with input validation and out-of-bounds error handling.
- Update command dispatch and error diagnostics to support task removal.
- Expand ui-test-plan.md with test cases for deletion, list renumbering, and dynamic capacity.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: add automatic file persistence and storage loading (Level-7, Save)
commitResults.messageBody:
- Implement Storage class with OS-independent relative paths for saving and loading tasks.

- Add polymorphic toFileFormat() methods to Task, Todo, Deadline, and Event.

- Automatically persist task list changes to disk upon add, mark, unmark, and delete.

- Support cold start with non-existent data directory/file and graceful recovery from corrupted records.

- Add data/ to .gitignore and enhance UI test isolation.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: add date and time parsing and date query command (Level-8, Dates and Times)
commitResults.messageBody:
- Implement DateTimeUtil with multi-format parsing (ISO, slash formats, 24-hour time) and formatted display.

- Upgrade Deadline and Event to store structured TaskDateTime objects.

- Validate that event end times do not precede start times.

- Add 'date' command to query deadlines and events occurring on a specified date.

- Update UI test suite to verify date-time parsing, formatting, and date filtering.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract Ui class for user interaction and persona dialogue
commitResults.messageBody:
- Extract Ui class to encapsulate console I/O, banner rendering, broadcast dividers, task feedback messages, and persona dialogue remarks.
- Refactor Braun to an instance-based coordinator delegating all display and input reading to Ui.
- Isolate presentation logic from control flow to uphold the Single Responsibility Principle as part of A-MoreOOP.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: organize codebase into domain packages (A-Packages)
commitResults.messageBody:
- Move classes from flat source root into modular packages: braun, braun.ui, braun.storage, braun.task, braun.util, and braun.exception.
- Add package declarations and explicit import statements across layers to enforce encapsulation.
- Update test-ui runner script to discover nested Java source files recursively and invoke braun.Braun.
- Maintain src/main/java as the primary source root for CS2103T standards.

commitResults.messageTitle: build: configure Gradle build for Braun application (A-Gradle)
commitResults.messageBody:
- Set application mainClass to braun.Braun in build.gradle.
- Configure shadowJar archiveFileName to braun.jar.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: add JUnit 5 test suite for core logic and update AI documentation (A-JUnit)
commitResults.messageBody:
- Add JUnit 5 unit test suites for DateTimeUtil, Storage, Event, and Ui.
- Cover date-time parsing, task serialization/deserialization, event interval validation, and persona dialogue matching.
- Update AGENTS.md with the 50% high-value method test coverage target and integrate gradlew test into the post-code update workflow.

commitResults.messageTitle: docs: complete JavaDoc comments across classes and methods (A-JavaDoc)
commitResults.messageBody:
- Add comprehensive header and parameter documentation for DateTimeUtil and TaskDateTime.
- Document UI layout constants DIVIDER and INDENT.
- Ensure 100% clean Javadoc generation with zero warnings via Gradle javadoc task.
